semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides essential components like connectors, flow control components, and seals that are crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai Duke Electronics specializes in manufacturing components and accessories for the semiconductor industry, including connectors, plugs, interconnects, cables, and wires. They also produce flow control components such as valves, meters, gauges, regulators, and mass flow controllers, as well as gaskets, seals, O-rings, elastomers, and resins.
capabilities: Connectors and interconnects for semiconductor equipment
Flow control components including valves and mass flow controllers
Seals and gaskets for semiconductor manufacturing
Elastomers and resins for semiconductor applications
